## Preferred workflow

1. Open STAT-TAB and select the needed dimensions manually.
2. Use dynamic selections such as “latest year” when available.
3. Retrieve that selection through the official API / JSON-stat route.
4. Decode it into a clean wide representation.
5. Inspect dimensions, modalities and totals.
6. Only then reshape to tidy/long data for joins, aggregation or visualization.

The GUI remains useful for understanding a cube; this recipe should not reproduce it.

## Aggregate diagnostic

OFS cubes can include aggregate categories in several dimensions at once—for example `Total`, `All` or `Overall`. Keeping overlapping aggregates alongside their subcategories can silently double, triple or quadruple counts.

Before summing, inspect:

- every dimension and its modalities;
- labels that represent totals or aggregates;
- whether totals equal the sum of visible subcategories;
- combinations where several dimensions are simultaneously aggregated;
- the row count and totals before and after each filter.

Any future diagnostic helper will report suspicious modalities and require an explicit user choice. It will never delete categories automatically.

The legacy `/sq/` CSV workflow and manual Windows-1252 conversion are intentionally not implemented. The current official endpoint, query export mechanism and JSON-stat decoding need verification before executable code is added; see the [roadmap](../ROADMAP.md).
